sources.title: Bitcoin consumes 'more electricity than Argentina'
sources.excerpt: Bitcoin uses more electricity annually than the whole of Argentina

sources.title: Cryptocurrencies that consume more electricity than an entire country
sources.excerpt: this figure exceeds the electricity consumption of countries such as Argentina

sources.title: Bitcoin Consumes as Much Electricity as Argentina—Cash Is the Sustainable Alternative – ICA
sources.excerpt: Bitcoin consumes as much electricity as an entire country—Argentina

reasoning: Multiple reports from the University of Cambridge (CBECI) and the International Monetary Fund (IMF) consistently confirm that Bitcoin's annual electricity consumption (estimated between 120 and 140 TWh) meets or exceeds the total electricity consumption of entire nations, including Argentina.
